slice: NORTH-WEST outer districts (Gò Vấp / District 12 / Tân Phú / Hóc Môn). SEPARATE from the other CREATORS_HCMC*.json files.
note: WebSearch-only research from a US region (WebFetch blocked by org egress). Per the honesty rule I did NOT invent any individual Vietnamese TikTok/YouTube/IG food vlogger, clip, or follower count — none could be verified with a specific findable clip + a real follower scale on a specific north-west-district place. Mê Coffee (700 teddy bears) is genuinely viral on TikTok, but rather than name an unverified creator I anchored it on the Kenh14 report of that virality plus a Viory video-wire clip. A follow-up local-language pass (Vietnamese TikTok/YouTube with named handles + follower counts) is the honest way to add creators for this slice.
